t: This is Our Most Holy Redeemer, a late nineteenth-century church in Clerkenwell, standing where Exmouth Market meets Rosebery Avenue. It's an Anglo-Catholic church in the Church of England's Diocese of London, and the church, clergy house, campanile and parish hall together are Grade II* listed. The architect was John Dando Sedding, who liked a crafted style of Gothic. He was an influential figure in the Arts and Crafts movement, and Ernest Gimson, Ernest Barnsley and Herbert Ibberson all studied in his offices.
